summary: CheerPlanner v2.2 SMS opt-in + Privacy Policy tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend 5/5 pytest cases passed against PATCH/GET /api/notifications/preferences with new sms_enabled/sms_phone/sms_consent_at fields. Frontend flows on /settings/notifications and /settings/privacy all work as spec'd once Metro rebundled the newly added files (Expo restart required — Metro was running in CI mode so hot reload was disabled). SMS opt-in normalizes 10-digit US numbers to +1XXXXXXXXXX, disables the phone input after opt-in, shows 'You're opted in.' subtitle, persists across reload, and toggling OFF re-enables editing. Privacy Policy screen renders with the required SMS / text message reminders section and is reachable from both notif-privacy-link and the Settings tab settings-privacy row.

react_native_issues.issue: Metro is started with CI=true (reloads disabled), so newly added files under /app/frontend/app/settings/privacy.tsx and edits to notifications.tsx / (tabs)/settings.tsx were not picked up until `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` was run. Before restart, /settings/privacy showed 'Unmatched Route' and the settings-privacy row was absent. Not a code bug — flag for awareness so future feature testing always restarts Expo after new route files are added. Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log ('Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled').

action_items: None required for the SMS opt-in / Privacy Policy features — both are working end-to-end.
Optional: when adding brand-new route files in future iterations, run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` because Metro is in CI mode and won't auto-detect new files.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.tsx toggleSmsConsent guard uses digits.length < 10 — this correctly blocks empty/short numbers. Verified behavior: with empty phone the switch does NOT flip to ON (state remained OFF and next-step toggle with a valid number succeeded). Note: page.on('dialog') did not capture the Alert.alert message because react-native-web renders Alert as an in-app modal, not window.alert — behavior is still correct.
notifications.py PATCH handler correctly persists sms_enabled/sms_phone/sms_consent_at, and setting sms_phone: null / sms_consent_at: null works (verified in cleanup test).
settings.tsx (Settings tab) correctly links to /settings/privacy via testID settings-privacy — visible after scrolling into the Help & support section.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test uses seeded applereview@cheerplanner.app account and resets sms_* fields to null at end of test module for idempotency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metro runs in CI mode — after E1 adds new expo-router route files, always `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` before running Playwright tests, otherwise new routes will render as 'Unmatched Route'. Login uses testIDs login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. Notification prefs GET/PATCH already returns sms_enabled/sms_phone/sms_consent_at.
